blocks.text: Liver (jigar) mein banne wale khaas proteins complement system banate hain. Is system mein darjan (12) se zyada mukhtalif proteins hain jo khoon mein ghair fa'al (inactive) haalat mein gardish karte rehte hain. Jab inhein koi microbe milta hai to yeh aik tarteeb se fa'al (active) hote hain: pehla protein doosre ko fa'al karta hai, doosra teesre ko, aur isi tarah aage. Aakhri paanch proteins microbe ki plasma membrane mein membrane-attack complex (MAC) banate hain. Yeh complex microbe ki plasma membrane mein soorakh kar deta hai. Is liye maya (fluids) aur namkiyat (salts) microbe ke andar chale jate hain, microbe phool jata hai aur phat jata hai.

blocks.alt: Jaraseem ki membrane (lipid bilayer) ka hissa jise membrane attack complex ke proteins ne chhed diya hai. Bahar se mayi ke teer is surakh se jaraseem ke cytoplasm mein neeche jate hain.
